privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.section1Text: First and last name, email and phone, date of birth, study group. For underage students the legal guardian's details are also stored. Technical data: device type, app version, sign-in time and IP address.
privacy.section2Text: To run the learning process: show courses and the schedule, accept homework and tests, award IT Coins, send notifications and build reports for the teacher and the parent. We do not use the data for advertising and never sell it.
privacy.section3Text: Only the processors without which the platform cannot work: the email service, the LiveKit video provider for classes and the push notification delivery service. Transfers are limited to the minimum necessary scope.
privacy.section4Text: Passwords are stored only as hashes, database access is role-based, and administrator actions are recorded in the audit log. Personal data is kept until the account is deleted or consent is withdrawn.
privacy.section5Text: You may request a copy of your data, correct it in your profile, withdraw consent and delete your account. After deletion personal data is anonymised while learning statistics are kept in anonymised form.
privacy.warning1: Your profile, photo and personal details will be deleted permanently.
privacy.warning2: You will be signed out on all devices and push notifications will stop.
privacy.warning3: Grades and progress are kept in anonymised form for course reporting.
privacy.confirmText: This action cannot be undone. Confirm deletion if you are sure.
privacy.deletedHint: Your data has been anonymised. Thank you for being with us.
